Qualifications

This proposal is based on plans prepared by: DMJA, sheets L-1 thru IR-1, Dated: January 31, 2025.

Landscape Install

This proposal reflects the take-off quantities shown on the plans. Shortages and undersized plant material are common in the landscaping industry due to current market conditions; therefore, height of shrubs per required container size cannot be guaranteed. This proposal may include increased container sizes to meet the requested specifications shown on the plant schedule. An add/deduct price can be provided for an additional cost. Mulch shall be Cocoa Brown per notes.

Material Availability

It is suggested to substitute Pinarf Schefflera with Trinette Schefflera.

Soil Samples & Amendments

Soil testing analysis results will determine if drainage sump gravel or amendments are necessary. Soil testing will be provided at no additional cost to the owner and/or developer. It is more cost effective to add sump gravel or amend soils with fertilizers and nutrients, should results show any deficiencies. These items can be provided for an additional price on “as needed” basis.

Exclusions

This proposal does not include tree protection, sod, littorals, or soil remediation.

Substitutions

Arbor-Brace tree anchoring system may be required depending on the availability of lumber for the 2 X 4 tree staking.

This project includes root barrier to protect the utility lines.

Fertilizer type is not specified; therefore, this proposal includes Agriform Tablets 20-10-5 as the Fertilizer.


Irrigation Install

Irrigation estimate is based  on Juniper Design/Build.

POC 2" Stub up behind each building.

Shrub adapters and sprays on plants. Bubblers on trees. Sprays on turf, No separation.

Hunter materials.

This estimate does not contain mainline, timer, wire or any other part of infrastructure. 

Estimate does NOT included any directional boring or concrete cutting.
